messages:
tess_release: FYI rolling SDK 4.0 tonight 02:00 UTC. There's a new affinity change: SDK now prefers capacity-class affinity (a100 > h100 > fallback). We need a concrete pin/unpin playbook to avoid misrouting on mixed pools.

omar_infra: Agree. My recommendation: pin by capacity-class for small/heterogeneous pools first rather than by region. Example: `rbctl runtime pin --capacity-class gpu_h100_fallback --runtime-version v3.1 --ttl 72h --reason "sdk4 affinity hold"`. This prevents autoscaler from allocating incompatible instances.

julia_eng: Note: our autoscaler sometimes mixes capacity classes in the same pool during scale-in/out. Deploybot supports capacity-class pins but mixed pools will enforce the stricter constraint and may block new allocs. Need to warn SRE.

nate_sre: Proposal: staged approach. 1) pre-stage pin for low-density pools (small_vm, gpu_h100_fallback) 2) run 15m canaries 3) if green, unpin and proceed to next cohort. Manual pin only. No auto-pinning.

zoe_prod: Dedicated tenants: update docs and add opt-out. We'll include migration steps in release notes and notify account managers.

julia_eng: SDK 4.0 also sends header X-REDWOOD-PREFER-CAPACITY. Runtimes <v3.1 ignore it and may misroute. We should backport a tiny shim to v3.1.1 in case we need to hotfix.

omar_infra: Ops commands for the playbook: 
```
# pin small fleets
rbctl runtime pin --capacity-class small_vm --runtime-version v3.1 --ttl 48h --reason "sdk4 safe-rollout"
# unpin after smoke
rbctl runtime unpin --capacity-class small_vm --reason "smoke passed"
```

tess_release: Triggers for unpin: decode mismatches <0.5% sustained 30m AND p99 latency within +200ms baseline AND no 5xx spikes. If any exceed, revert pins immediately and file rollback ticket.

nate_sre: Add monitoring: deploybot will post telemetry but not auto-pin. If p99 > baseline+300ms for 10m, deploybot posts alert with a runbook link. Manual owners: @tess_release & oncall SRE.

joelia_eng: small correction: runtime shim PR created and will be tagged v3.1.1. If we need it, deploy to small_vm pools first.

zoe_prod: Drafted release note paragraph and tenant migration KB. Will link in the SDK changelog PR.

deploybot: [deploybot] canary schedule: small_vm 02:15 UTC (15m), gpu_h100_fallback 02:35 UTC (15m), a100_highdensity 03:00 UTC (30m).

omar_infra: One more: ensure quota alerts for blocked allocs are enabled; pinning could cause allocation failures for bursts. Add a playbook step to check quota and scale-down tolerances.

tess_release: OK locking plan. We'll execute pre-stage pin 01:45 UTC, run canaries, then lift pins sequentially if green. Manual unpin only once criteria meet. Closing thread unless someone has more asks.
